# 只计自身的取用漏掉联合超出：各自在所给之内，合起来可以超出；联合超出持续不过原有的；更新者依存于所更新者时，它终结更新与以其所需依存者，取用者以这样的需要依存时也在内 / Counting one's own draw misses joint excess: each within what is given, together they can exceed it; joint excess cannot outlast what was held; where renewers depend on what they renew, it ends the renewal and those depending at such a need, a taker among them where it so depends

## 主张 Claim

一步中每个参与的形成从一个条件取用都不多于该步给予它的，称为各自在所给之内（Flow.WithinOwn）；它们合起来取用不多于所给，称为联合地在所给之内（Flow.WithinJoint）。各自在所给之内，合起来可以超出（Pair.own_not_joint）。在平衡的流中，联合地在所给之内时水平不下降（Flow.joint_keeps）；联合超出的一步使水平至少下降一（Flow.excess_lowers），所以连续 n 步联合超出需要起点水平至少为 n（Flow.excess_bounded）；两个形成每步各取一单位、只给回一单位时，没有任何网使流平衡（Pair.no_web）。每个向条件给予的形成都以至少 m 的需要依存于它、只有活跃者给予（Acting）、活动需要支持（Dependent）时，水平一旦低于 m，以后每步都低于 m（Flow.stays_below），以至少 m 的需要依存于它的每个形成从那以后都不活跃（Flow.ends_below）；所以从低于 n + m 的水平起连续 n 步联合超出，终结更新者与以至少 m 的需要依存于该条件的每个形成，取用者以这样的需要依存时也在内；不依存或以较低需要依存的取用者可以延续（Flow.joint_excess_ends）。Exceeding 中一个更新者给予两单位，两个取用者各取两单位，每个都在所给之内，满足平衡、Acting、Dependent 与给予的门控，从第二步起三者都不活跃（Exceeding.all_end；这一终结也由其活动规定，见证表明它与这些定律相容）；只有一个取用者时，同一更新者保持水平，二者每步都活跃（Alone.all_continue）。不用伦理前提，也不用 Lean 公理。 / A formation's take from a condition across a step is within what is given when no formation taking part takes more than the step gives the condition (Flow.WithinOwn); the formations take jointly within what is given when their total take is at most what is given (Flow.WithinJoint). Each can take within what is given while together they take more (Pair.own_not_joint). In a balanced flow, taking jointly within what is given keeps the level (Flow.joint_keeps); a step of joint excess lowers it by at least one (Flow.excess_lowers), so n consecutive steps of joint excess need a level of at least n at the start (Flow.excess_bounded), and with two formations each taking a unit at every step and one unit given back no web balances the flow (Pair.no_web). Where every formation giving to the condition depends on it at a need of at least m, only active formations give (Acting) and activity needs support (Dependent), a level below m stays below m at every later step (Flow.stays_below), and every formation depending on the condition at a need of at least m is inactive from then on (Flow.ends_below); so n consecutive steps of joint excess from a level below n + m end the renewers and every formation depending on the condition at a need of at least m, a taker among them where it so depends; a taker not depending on it, or depending at a lower need, can continue (Flow.joint_excess_ends). In Exceeding a renewer gives two units and two takers each take two, each within what the step gives; balance, Acting, Dependent and the gate hold, and from step two on none of the three is active (Exceeding.all_end; the ending is also stipulated in its activity, and the witness shows it consistent with these laws); with one taker the same renewer keeps the level and both are active at every step (Alone.all_continue). No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used.

## 前提与对应 Hypotheses and correspondence

- 平衡：条件水平的每次变化都是参与者的取用与给予。 / Balance: every change of a condition's level is what those taking part take and give.
- 门控：每个向条件给予的形成都以至少 m 的需要依存于它；只有活跃者给予（Acting）；活动需要支持（Dependent）。这是更新依存于所更新者的形式，不是一般的更新。 / The gate: every formation giving to the condition depends on it at a need of at least m; only active formations give (Acting); activity needs support (Dependent). This is renewal depending on what it renews, not renewal in general.
- 超出的计数是每步的总量，不问每个取用者的份额；各自在所给之内比较的是每个取用者与该步的全部给予。 / Excess is counted on totals at each step, not on shares; within what is given compares each taker with the whole of the step's giving.

Ren 的提议说，自我可以变得僵硬，“has to count the dynamics that happens beyond what the "self" sees”。外围的磨损定律已有同一现象：两个部分各在更新之内、只合起来超出时，共享的形成随之终止（renewing-consuming-formation 中的 jointly_exceeding_parts_end_shared_formation）。本结果把它陈述在脊柱上，以支持门控的网的形式，不用磨损定律：更新者依存于所更新者，联合超出使水平低于其需要，更新停止，以其所需依存者终结，取用者以这样的需要依存时也在内。两个模型没有实例定理相连，联系是诠释性的。作者的读法（AI 论证）：元吸引子选出取用更多的形成，它们起初形成更多，每步的计数偏好它们；各自只计自身的取用，合起来超出更新，共享的条件终结，以其所需依存于它的随之终结，胜者如此依存时也在内。想要的延续比共享条件所存更长远时，它必须计入对其所依存者的联合取用；n 步联合超出只需要 n 的水平，视界较短的想要可以在联合超出中被全部满足（Mortal，见 derived-extent-limits）。这是想要所要求的，不是对它的判决。 / Ren's proposal says that the self can become rigid and “has to count the dynamics that happens beyond what the "self" sees”. The periphery's wear law has the same phenomenon: where two parts are each within renewal and only jointly exceed it, the shared formation ceases with them (jointly_exceeding_parts_end_shared_formation in renewing-consuming-formation). This result states it on the spine, as a support-gated web and without the wear law: renewers depend on what they renew, joint excess brings the level below their need, renewal stops and those depending at such a need end, a taker among them where it so depends. No instance theorem joins the two models; the link is interpretive. The author's reading (an AI argument): the meta-attractor selects formations that take more; they form more at first and a count over a step prefers them; each counts its own draw, together they exceed renewal, the shared condition ends, and with it what depends on it at such a need, the winners among them where they so depend. A formation that wants its continuation beyond what the shared condition holds must count the joint draw on what it depends on; n steps of joint excess need only a level of n, so a want with a shorter horizon can be fully met amid joint excess (Mortal, see derived-extent-limits). This is what the want requires, not a verdict passed on it.
